chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Whoever recites this verse at the time of his sleep: 'Say, I am only a human being like you; it is revealed to me that your God is One God' to the end of it
a light will shine for him to al-Masjid al-Haram, the midst of that light being filled with angels seeking forgiveness for him until morning.

key_terms.اَلْآيَةَ: the Qur'anic verse being recommended for recitation
key_terms.مَنَامِهِ: the time of going to sleep
key_terms.نُورٌ: a spiritual light granted as a reward
key_terms.يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ: they seek forgiveness on behalf of the reciter
key_terms.يُوحَىٰ: is revealed; indicating divine revelation to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the final verse of Surah al-Kahf before sleeping?
ai.summary: This hadith states the merit of reciting the closing verse of Surah al-Kahf before sleep. It promises a divinely granted light extending to al-Masjid al-Haram and angels who seek forgiveness for the reciter until morning, highlighting the spiritual blessing of Qur'an recitation and the affirmation of tawhid.
